title: Local-first Botora Desktop Package

assessment_snapshot.intro: The project profile describes a JavaScript application being adapted into an installable local-first Electron product:
bullets: 19,884 lines of JavaScript across backend/, frontend/, and docs/; topology grouping is not required.
The stated target is Windows and Ubuntu desktop with local backend, UI, database, and WhatsApp runtime; Electron version remains to be determined.
botora-admin remains the remote central service for accounts, subscriptions, and credits; external runtime assets and production authentication configuration are verification risks.

proposed_outcome: Package the existing product as a local-first Electron desktop application for Windows and Ubuntu, with its backend, UI, database, persistent user data, and WhatsApp runtime operating on the user's computer, while preserving the remote botora-admin service for central accounts, subscriptions, and credits. Keep the work in-place on work_desktop, preserve unrelated work, avoid Android and cloud deployment changes, and do not commit or push.
